programme.title: Football - Spanish league: Villarreal CF - Getafe CF 08.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.

programme.title: Basket 3x3 - World Tour: Zaisan, grupna faza
programme.desc: Fiba World Tour 3 na 3 za razliku od World Cupa uključuje momčadi iz pojedinih gradova dok na World Cup pravo natjecanja imaju nacionalni timovi. Kao vrhunac 3 na 3 košarke World Tour natjecanje pod okriljem Fibe od 2012. godine mami uzdahe ljubitelja ovog dinamičnog sporta. Temeljna razlika između klasične dvoranske košarke je broj igrača na terenu, a to je po tri u svakoj momčadi. Bitne razlike su još, da se igra na polovici standardnog košarkaškog terena na jedan koš. programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga: Tofas - Trabzonspor
programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Rukomet - Njemačka liga: Berlin - Kiel
programme.desc: Rukometna Bundesliga je najviši rang rukometnih takmičenja u Njemačkoj. Uz špansku ligu, Bundesliga se smatra najboljom evropskom ligom. Osnovana je 1965. godine kao odvojeno takmičenje sjeverne i južne regije. Tek od 1977. deluje kao jedinstveno takmičenje. Trenutno broji 19 ekipa u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Najviše osvojenih titula broji rukometni klub Kil. Visok kvalitet rukometne igre i ispunjene tribine razlog su zašto je Bundesliga toliko praćena u cijelom svijetu.

programme.title: Košarka - Grčka liga: Panathinaikos - Kolossos
programme.desc: Grčka A1 pod nadzorom HEBE (Grčki košarkaški savez) smatra se jednom od najjačih liga sveta nakon neprikosnovene američke NBA lige. Liga se sastoji od 14 timova i igra se u periodu od oktobra do juna u kojem svaki tim odigra 26 utakmica za vreme regularnog dela. Nakon što su sve ekipe odigrale međusobno po dva susreta na domaćem i gostujućem terenu po osam timova igra plejof u kojemu se dobija prvak. Prvo službeno takmičenje se održalo u sezoni 1927-1928, dok se plejof pojavio tek 1986-1987. godine. Uz mega popularne ekipe Panatinajkos i Olimpijakos tu se nalaze još i timovi kao što su Aris i AEK koji su ostavili trag u evropskoj košarci.

programme.title: Little Big Fred
programme.desc: Il a passé sa vie entière sous les projecteurs, avant d'être aspiré par ses ténèbres intérieures. Désormais consultant, Fred Weis a été un joueur de basket au talent précoce et un précurseur. Du haut de ses 2,17m, le pivot a porté l'équipe de France jusqu'à la finale des Jeux olympiques 2000 face aux Etats-Unis et a prouvé que la fluidité et l'intelligence de jeu n'étaient pas réservées aux petits gabarits. Courtisé par les plus grands clubs, en Europe comme aux Etats-Unis, il renonce finalement à faire le grand saut vers la NBA préférant revenir soutenir son club de coeur, Limoges. Sa carrière exemplaire est subitement chamboulée par la découverte de l'autisme de son fils, un choc qui l'entraine dans une spirale autodestructrice, jusqu'à envisager les solutions les plus radicales.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master named 'Shadow Whip', he is suspected and hunted.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching, a 17-year-old girl who marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when Li decides to go to the same school with her husband but attempting to hide their relationship.

programme.title: The Web Of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called 'Five Poison Web', spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: As a scholar and his lover are torn apart forever by his uncle and his friend, and drive the girl to commit suicide. The girl returns as ghost and seek revenge.

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women give birth to baby girls by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix is yet another masterpiece from director Li Han-hsiang. It is a comedy surrounded the upcoming marriage of the imperial minister's daughter.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Perennial martial-arts villain Shek Kin takes on a rare comedic role as a playful ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his feuding parents.

programme.title: Return Of The Sentimental...
programme.desc: Return Of The Sentimental...

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: The Monkey King and his gang are confronted by the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her two sexy sisters, plus a cast of fanciful characters.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: As the roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collected proofs of corruption from the officials, they demanded to become the governor of the country.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Word gets out that blind Ku has the secret of the Buddha's Palm and he is besieged by everything from terrifying giant birds to gangs of martial arts warriors.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Roving swordsman Tu Meng-Fei chances to rescue a female pupil Mu Wan-Erh and later, another girl Li Sai-Nan from underworld leader Leng Tien-Lei. Li wants to take vengeance on Leng who murdered her parents.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: Chou Lian Huan is good at fist fighting in Shanghai. In order to please a hostess named Chen Ju Fang, he is willing to sacrifice everything and fight against the son of the gang leader in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: The story evolves around Lin Shao-teh, a poor student who was engaged to Chien-king, the daughter of billionaire Wang Chun.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin
programme.desc: An award-winning film in 1978. Liu Yu-Te escapes to Shaolin Temple, mastered the skill of 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers. Succeeded his revenge and introduced the 36th Chamber.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond.

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, a gang of loyalists led by Yang Chi-ching and Lin Dai, strive to drive a wedge between the governor and his son, eventually turning them against each other.

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua as a swordswoman out to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the sharpest blade in the world.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: A wealthy womanizer writes a diary about his romantic escapades, but the women with whom he’s been intimate have all been murdered.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: To Kill A Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: A schizophrenic who refuses to believe her pilot lover was killed and believes his death to be a lie created to end their relationship.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: The Great Magician (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A Chinese warlord hires a conjurer to help him impress a resistant concubine.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 2
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: The story of legendary Guan Yu crossing five passes And slaying six generals. He played a major role in the civil war that led to the collapse of Han Dynasty And the establishment of Shu Han of the 3 Kingdoms, making Liu Bei its first emperor.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: The Stormriders (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: My Darling Genie

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Son Donglu, a newly promoted detective teams up with Guo Zhui, fastest gunman in Tiancheng and Xiaowu, a novice policeman to investigate the mystery deaths in a bullet factory.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Furious Attack (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Olympique Lyon - Między legendą a teraźniejszością
programme.desc: Olympique Lyon to jeden z najsłynniejszych klubów we Francji. Jego złota era przypadła na pierwszą dekadę XXI wieku, kiedy to siedmiokrotnie sięgnął po mistrzostwo Ligue 1. Twórcy filmu przypominają tamte sukcesy i przedstawiają wyzwania obecnie stojące przed Les Gones.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio

programme.title: Najlepsi obrońcy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.title: Najlepsi bramkarze Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych bramkarzy lat 90., którzy zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy Olivera Kahna, Gabora Kiraly'a, Jensa Lehmanna czy Dirka Heynena.

programme.title: Legendy ligi niemieckiej

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Moi bohaterowie
programme.desc: Joshua KimmichJoshua Kimmich to jeden z najzdolniejszych defensywnych piłkarzy młodego pokolenia w Niemczech. Jest filarem Bayernu Monachium i reprezentacji Niemiec. To jeden z tych zawodników, do których należy piłkarska przyszłość.

programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi
programme.desc: Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio
programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.

programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.

programme.title: HHH - Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą historię jednego z najważniejszych zespołów niemieckiej piłki. Hamburger SV sześć razy zdobywał tytuł mistrza Niemiec. Aktualnie drużyna gra w 2. Bundeslidze i stara się wrócić do elity niemieckiej piłki klubowej.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund
programme.desc: Michael Zorc, Stéphane Chapuisat, Robert Lewandowski, Andreas Moller to tylko niektórzy spośród piłkarzy Borussii Dortmund, którzy potrafili zdobywać bramki w zadziwiający sposób. W programie widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole w wykonaniu zawodników BVB.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04
programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: SC Freiburg - 1. FC Union Berlin
programme.desc: Freiburg imponuje formą. Po ośmiu kolejkach znajduje się na trzeciej lokacie i traci zaledwie 2 punkty do liderującego Bayernu Monachium. Przeskoczyć aktualnego mistrza Niemiec chce starciem z Unionem. programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Najszybsze gole Bundesligi
programme.desc: W tym programie zobaczymy bramki, które padły zaraz po pierwszym gwizdku sędziego. Okazuje się, że w historii Bundesligi gole strzelone w pierwszych sekundach spotkań wcale nie należały do rzadkości. Niektóre z nich naprawdę warto zobaczyć.

programme.desc: Atalanta od początku sezonu miała bić się o miejsca pozwalające na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Jednak zamiast pierwszej czwórki bliżej jest strefy spadkowej, nad którą ma 4 oczka przewagi. Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Hamburger SV - Borussia Mönchengladbach
programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Paris Saint-Germain - ESTAC Troyes
programme.desc: Po gorszym początku sezonu Paryżanie wrócili do poziomu, którym zachwycali kibiców na całym świecie. W poprzedniej serii spotkań wygrali z Le Havre AC aż 5:1. W 10. kolejce Paris Saint-Germain podejmie ESTAC Troyes. Przyjezdni odnieśli ostatnio drugie ligowe zwycięstwo w tym sezonie, pokonując 2:0 Le Mans FC.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: VfB Stuttgart - Werder Brema
programme.desc: Werder Brema w ubiegły weekend przedłużył serię bez porażki, wygrywając 2:0 z TSG Hoffenheim. W najbliższej kolejce podopieczni Daniela Thioune zagrają na wyjeździe z VfB Stuttgart. Gospodarze również sięgnęli po trzy punkty w poprzedniej serii spotkań, pokonując 4:2 Bayer Leverkusen.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Toulouse FC - RC Strasbourg
programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.desc: Historia Hamburgera SV, jednego z najbardziej utytułowanych klubów piłkarskich Bundesligi. Twórcy analizują m.in. sezon 2017/2018, kiedy popularne Dinozaury po raz pierwszy w swojej historii spadły z najwyższej klasy rozgrywkowej.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04
programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Paris Saint-Germain - ESTAC Troyes
programme.desc: Po gorszym początku sezonu Paryżanie wrócili do poziomu, którym zachwycali kibiców na całym świecie. W poprzedniej serii spotkań wygrali z Le Havre AC aż 5:1. W 10. kolejce Paris Saint-Germain podejmie ESTAC Troyes. Przyjezdni odnieśli ostatnio drugie ligowe zwycięstwo w tym sezonie, pokonując 2:0 Le Mans FC.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - Atalanta BC

Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.title: NBA Action
programme.desc: Weekly magazine about NBA happenings.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league: New York - Cleveland
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: NBA Daily
programme.desc: Follow the sports magazine about all the happenings in the NBA league.

programme.title: Football (M) U19 European Championship: Serbia - Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Who are the future stars of European and world football? What is certain in these championships is that we will see uncertain matches until the end.

programme.title: Fudbal - Engleska liga: Nottingham Forest - Manchester City
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: Football - Mozart Bet Super League: Vojvodina - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and operates according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white team is more successful.

programme.title: Football - Mozart Bet Superliga
programme.desc: See the best moments, goals and chances in the round review of the Serbian Superliga.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Partizan - Baskonia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: KZN - Football Association of Serbia
programme.desc: Pratite konferenciju za medije povodom fudbalske utakmice reprezentacije Srbije.

programme.title: Football - U21 friendly match: Serbia - North Macedonia
programme.desc: U21 national teams today have their own parallel competition system compared to their senior colleagues. Football fans all over the world follow with great attention the competitions of the youth national teams, which have become as popular as the senior competitions over time. In periods when there are no official qualifying matches or major competitions, the young U21 national teams play international friendly matches. They serve selectors to try out various tactical ideas and players to assert themselves and show that they belong in the best team.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za EP U19: Srbija - Farska Ostrva
programme.desc: Osim prilike da svoju zemlju odličnim igrama odvedu na Evropsko prvenstvo, kvalifikacioni ciklus za momke ispod 19 godina nam pruža mogućnost da među mladim talentima prepoznamo i naznake budućih zvezda evropskog i svetskog fudbala.

programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga: Zadar - Partizan
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season.

programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga: Korfez - Galatasaray
programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta.
